request.spec:
The consolidated figures gain, per grade on any sheet of the tree, the due-totals of the people on
that grade (retired people left out) added up over the tree, and per status the count of claims in
that status over the tree.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The consolidated figures gain, per grade on any sheet of the tree, the due-totals of the people on
that grade (retired people left out) added up over the tree, and per status the count of claims in
that status over the tree.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The consolidated figures now also show, for each grade, the due-totals added up over the sheet and all its descendant sheets, and for each status, the number of claims over the tree. `bin/e2e` runs all 4 tests in the spec and they pass.

- **Where the change is:** it's front-end only, in `src/main/frontend/features/counters/ConsolidatedFigures.tsx`. The existing consolidated figures were already worked out in the browser from each sheet's stored data, so nothing changed in the stored data or on the server.
- **Per grade:** each sheet's figure is worked out the same way as that sheet's own summary table: retired people are left out and "n/a" values are skipped. Those figures are then added up across the tree into `consolidated-grade-<A|B|C>-due-total`.
- **Per status:** claims with each status are counted on every sheet and summed into `consolidated-status-<STATUS>-count`, for the same six statuses the header shows.
- **One other edit:** in `HeaderCounters.tsx`, the list of statuses is now exported so the consolidated figures use the same list instead of keeping a copy.

When the screen shows a sheet as of a date, the new figures use every sheet as it stood at the end of that day, like the existing consolidated figures do.
